title: Nvidia Asked to Sell Chips to Companies Tied to Chinese Military and Megaspeed
summary: Lawmakers released confidential information showing the Commerce Department had approved sales of more than 800,000 A.I. chips to Chinese companies, some with military ties.
body_markdown: Lawmakers released confidential information showing the Commerce Department had approved sales of more than 800,000 A.I. chips to Chinese companies, some with military ties.
